findings.detail: Persistent read has two binding reads, each with two full verifySensitivity calls. Successful cold read invokes four full replays. First evaluate/store invokes bind with one precommit replay plus its two replays on readback, then final persistent read with four: seven. Already-bound retry evaluates sensitivity before readByRequest, then invokes two replays through previous binding and four through final read: six plus the calculation. Counts assume successful unchanged canonical path. Each full replay resolves units/C08 sources/samples/C10, reproduces exact search and adjacent witnesses, and captures source/authority fences.
